gold_assessment.reasoning: Gold: patient presents with anxiety symptoms. Generated cc-001: patient reports feeling really anxious for ~2 months. Chief complaint of anxiety is present, with added duration detail.
Gold: two‑month history of feeling anxious all the time. Generated cc-001 and hpi-001 both describe ~2-month history of anxiety; content is captured with added job detail.

Gold: anxiety began after starting a new job in a different industry with pressure from boss. Generated hpi-001: onset ~2 months ago with new stressful job in fashion‑retail head office; mentions job stress and boss in hpi-002. Equivalent with added industry detail.

Gold: dreads going to work every morning. Generated hpi-002: daily morning dread about leaving the house and persistent worry regarding job performance and interactions with boss. The morning dread related to work is captured (slightly expanded).
Gold: severe initial insomnia with ~3 hours to fall asleep. Generated hpi-003: goes to bed 22:00–23:00 with sleep latency of hours. Same clinical concept; sleep-onset insomnia with prolonged latency.
Gold: early-morning waking. Generated hpi-005: wakes before alarm with racing heart. Captures early-morning awakening and adds symptom detail (racing heart).
Gold: often only 3–4 hours sleep. Generated hpi-004: total sleep perceived 3–4 h with shallow quality. Same duration, with extra quality descriptor.

Gold: feels tired during the day. Generated hpi-004: shallow sleep and 3–4 hours; though daytime tiredness is not explicit there, it appears in ROS only as insomnia and low mood. However, tiredness is a reasonable inference but not explicitly stated in generated facts. No direct match; so this is actually not explicitly covered. Status changed to OMITTED.
Gold: patient reports low energy. Generated hpi-009: very low energy. Directly matches with added emphasis.

Gold: eating pattern normal but more chocolate. Generated ros-006: denies significant appetite change, aside from slightly increased chocolate intake. Captures the same idea with slightly more wording.

Gold: anhedonia at work and outside; previously enjoyed running, tennis, socialising but now often avoids. Generated hpi-010 and hpi-013 and sh-006: report anhedonia, decreased participation in running/tennis and social avoidance. Content is covered, though the nuance 'still sees friends but often avoids' is simplified to 'social avoidance'.

Gold: palpitations began with anxiety symptoms. Generated hpi-008: palpitations first noted within current 2‑month period (same as onset of anxiety). This corresponds to starting with anxiety symptoms.

Gold: palpitations feel irregular and with chest discomfort. Generated hpi-006 and hpi-007, ros-008: irregular rapid heartbeat; denies true chest pain, only discomfort from forceful beats. This is consistent with 'chest discomfort' and subjectively irregular palpitations.
Gold: palpitations are rapid and last approx 2–10 minutes. Generated hpi-006: irregular rapid heartbeat lasting minutes (up to 10 min). Duration and rapid character are captured.
Gold: has not missed work. Generated hpi-012: still attending work but contemplates calling in sick. Confirms attendance; no missed work, with extra detail about contemplation.

Gold: public transport is another trigger provoking anxiety. Generated hpi-014: work stress and public transport (tube, warm airless conditions) aggravate symptoms. Same trigger, with extra specificity.
Gold: feels low mood most of the time. Generated hpi-011 and ros-004: feels down most days; positive for low mood. Matching concept and frequency.

Gold: no past psychiatric history or significant anxiety. Generated facts include hpi-016 (no previous episodes of similar severity) but this does not explicitly state 'no past psych history/significant anxiety'—only that severity is new. Therefore not fully captured.
Gold: mother has history of depression. Generated fhx-001: same statement. Direct match.

Gold: lives with supportive parents. Generated sh-001: lives with parents. Supportiveness is omitted, but living situation is captured; main fact partially covered. Marked as COVERED with minor loss of nuance.
Gold: drinks Fri/Sat, sometimes overdoes it. Generated sh-003: binge pattern most Fri/Sat over limit, plus occasional weekday wine. Friday/Saturday pattern and overuse are captured with added detail.
Gold: smokes occasionally. Generated sh-004: occasional cigarettes. Same content.
Gold: no illicit drugs. Generated sh-005: denies recreational drug use. Equivalent.
Gold: work-related anxiety. Generated asm-001: work-related anxiety disorder / possible GAD. Base assessment is captured with additional differential detail.
Gold: insomnia. Generated asm-002: insomnia secondary to anxiety. Same diagnosis with added causation.
Gold: advised self-referral to NHS talking therapies. Generated plan-001: provide NHS self-referral link for CBT. Same plan with extra description of CBT.
Gold: access online CBT resources. Generated plan-002: share reputable online self-help resources for anxiety management. Slightly broader wording but clearly encompasses online CBT-type resources.

Gold: blood tests as initial investigation for palpitations; to book via support team. Generated plan-007 and plan-008: order blood tests (specific panels) and patient to phone support line to schedule phlebotomy. Core plan is captured, with added detail on which tests.

Same safety/return instructions, with extra conditions and symptom examples.
Gold: patient reports no panic attacks. Generated ROS does not mention panic attacks at all. Thus omitted.
Gold: denies suicidal ideation. Generated ros-010 and hpi-011: denies suicidal thoughts/ideation or intent. Same content.

gen_assessment.reasoning: Captures chief complaint of anxiety; adds 2‑month duration supported by hpi-001.
Onset ~2 months ago and linked to new job stress align with gold hpi-001 and hpi-002. Added detail of 'fashion‑retail head office' is an ADDITION but non-contradictory.
Daily morning dread and worry about job performance/boss correspond to dread of work every morning and job pressure. Extra content about leaving the house is an ADDITION.
Describes prolonged sleep latency (hours), consistent with severe initial insomnia taking ~3 hours to fall asleep.
Total sleep 3–4 h matches gold; 'shallow quality' is additional descriptive detail.
Waking before alarm fits early‑morning waking; 'racing heart' is added linkage to palpitations, consistent with gold palpitations facts.
Irregular rapid heartbeat lasting minutes up to 10 min aligns with palpitations description and duration in hpi-012 and hpi-013; 'most often on waking' is additional detail, not in gold.

Gold notes chest discomfort; generated clarifies as no true chest pain, only discomfort from forceful beats. This refines but does not contradict; consistent with ROS gold which does not mention chest pain explicitly but is compatible.
Palpitations first noted within current 2‑month anxiety period; matches that they started with anxiety symptoms.
Very low energy is consistent with gold report of low energy; wording is slightly stronger but not contradictory.
Reports anhedonia, directly aligning with gold anhedonia at work and outside (specific contexts further detailed elsewhere).
Feels down most days corresponds to low mood most of the time; denial of suicidal ideation aligns with ros-002.
Still attending work matches 'not missed work'; contemplating calling in sick is additional nuance but not contradictory.
Decreased running/tennis and social avoidance corresponds to reduced previously enjoyed activities and often avoiding socialising. Slightly stronger wording but directionally consistent.
Work stress and public transport as triggers match gold; description of tube environment is additional detail.
Relievers: none identified and has discussed with mother are not specified in any gold facts. No contradiction, but entirely additional information.

States no previous episodes of similar severity. Gold only notes no past psychiatric history/significant anxiety; severity comparison is not documented. This is new information but does not contradict.
Positive for anxiety is consistent with chief complaint and overall HPI; not explicitly listed in gold ROS section but fully aligned with the record. Treated as consistent SUPPORTED extension.
Positive for palpitations is consistent with multiple gold HPI palpitations facts; gold ROS doesn’t list them, but there is no conflict.
Positive for insomnia accords with described initial insomnia/EMW and diagnosis of insomnia; consistent.
Positive for low mood matches gold report of low mood most of the time.
Denies weight loss is not mentioned in any gold fact. New, non-contradictory ROS detail.
Denies significant appetite change aside from slightly increased chocolate intake matches 'eating pattern normal but more chocolate.'
Denies syncope is not present in gold facts. New ROS item without conflict.

Matches gold: mother has depression.
